in_marathi.name: Aksithi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aksithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aksithi is a Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aksita'. The name means 'immutable' or 'incomparable'. In Hindu mythology, Aksithi is associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her unwavering devotion to her husband Shiva and her unchanging love. It is a name that symbolizes stability, consistency, and unwavering commitment.
